operators.name: abs_div_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as reference step input, e.g. [2048,256,512]

semantics: Computes element-wise abs(x) then divides result by divisor (integer scalar), equivalent to torch.abs(x) followed by torch.div(x, divisor).
Input x is a CUDA float32 tensor with arbitrary strides; the kernel must handle non-contiguous layouts or the binding may require contiguous.
Output is a new CUDA float32 tensor with the same shape as x, allocated by the binding.
The divisor is an integer but multiplication by reciprocal or float division is acceptable as long as numerical result matches torch.div within tolerance.
No broadcasting beyond scalar divisor; all elements are processed independently.
Returns a tensor (not a tuple or list).
Element-wise absolute value of input tensor x.
Input x is a CUDA float32 tensor of shape [2048,256,512].
Output has same shape and dtype, new tensor.
Element-wise division of result from step_001 by scalar self.divisor (integer).
Broadcasting scalar divisor to all elements.
Output is a CUDA float32 tensor with shape [2048,256,512].
